vibespace.consent.gate.strong: Isolation: strong (sandboxed worker, no network, no host environment).
vibespace.consent.gate.poc: Isolation: proof of concept on Windows. The shell gate stays closed until its CI checks pass.
vibespace.consent.gate.proxy: Tool network: goes through the broker-owned domain proxy. Only domains you allow are reachable.
vibespace.consent.gate.elevated: Elevated mode: this command runs WITHOUT a sandbox. You set this mode up explicitly; every command is asked separately.
vibespace.consent.gate.unavailable: Process execution is not available on this platform.
vibespace.consent.gate.unavailable.macos: Process execution is not available on macOS in this alpha. There is no fallback.

vs.health.title: Selected model health
vs.health.boundary: Read-only check. No downloads. Native Vibe rechecks the exact model before every request. Local-only permits verified Ollama only; LM Studio remains blocked when unknown. This trusts daemon metadata, not an audit of its implementation.
vs.onboard.title: Local model readiness
vs.onboard.intro: Find a local server before starting. This check never downloads, loads or runs a model.
vs.onboard.boundary: Manual recheck only after this first check. A server response does not prove installation or local execution. Up to three Ollama models are checked here; Vibe checks the exact chosen model again before each request. LM Link can route localhost to a different device, so LM Studio stays blocked in local-only mode.
vs.onboard.next.ollama.unavailable: Open the desktop app to check Ollama.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.unavailable: Open the desktop app to check LM Studio.
vs.onboard.state.down: Server not reachable or access denied
vs.onboard.next.ollama.down: Start Ollama, then choose Check again. If it is not installed, install it yourself first.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.down: Start LM Studio Local Server. Check its port and access settings, then try again.
vs.onboard.next.ollama.invalid: Check Ollama server status, then try again.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.invalid: Update or check LM Studio REST API v1 support.
vs.onboard.next.ollama.empty: Add a model yourself in Ollama, then check again. Somnia will not download it.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.empty: Add and load a model yourself in LM Studio. Nothing is downloaded here.
vs.onboard.state.unverified: Models listed; local execution not verified
vs.onboard.next.ollama.unverified: Open AI settings to inspect models. Choose a model with local weights, not a cloud tag.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.unverified: LM Studio is detected, but LM Link can use another device. Use verified Ollama for local-only.
vs.onboard.next.ollama.local: Choose this exact model in AI settings, save, then select it for this Studio.
vs.onboard.next.lmstudio.local: Use verified Ollama for local-only; LM Studio execution location is not verified.
vs.stream.title: Experimental live output
vs.stream.state.failed: Stream failed: partial output kept, incomplete
vs.stream.boundary: Provisional text is display-only, not a project change. Apply stays blocked while output is partial. Completed changes need a separate native review and your Apply decision. Stopped/failed streams are not replayed automatically. Usage can arrive only at the end.
